platform: Illumina HiSeq 2000 (GPL16791), hg19 / Ensembl GRCh37.82 Cufflinks RPKM
contrast_description: primary HF_vs_NF = (DCM + ICM)/2 - NF, 50 HF (37 DCM + 13 ICM) vs 14 NF; DCM_vs_NF and ICM_vs_NF fitted in the same model and recorded as extra `contrast` rows; positive log2FC = higher in disease
method: limma on log2(RPKM+1); Ensembl annotations collapsed to HGNC symbols by max mean expression; 999999999 sentinel cells -> NA; expression filter RPKM>0 in >=25% of samples; lmFit(~0+group) with group in {NF,DCM,ICM} + eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE)
covariates: group only (three levels); sex, age and other clinical covariates not modelled; the DCM and ICM arms are reported as separate contrasts
reproducibility: deterministic; re-running build_deg.R reproduces the CSV sha256 exactly
